facts.fact: Ration cards (AAY and PHH) under NFSA are issued and managed by the respective State Government / UT Administration (its food department), not by the Centre
facts.quote: Identification of beneficiaries/households under the National Food Security Act, 2013 (NFSA) and issuance of Antodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration cards is dealt by the respective State Government / UT Administration.

facts.fact: The application procedure is on the respective State/UT Food Portal, linked from nfsa.gov.in
facts.quote: To apply for a new ration card or to know the procedure of application, kindly visit the respective State/UT Food Portals by clicking here .

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; says that adding a child's name (a change to the ration card) is done by the State/UT food department, names it and links the State food portal via nfsa.gov.in (G12 - named, not refused); does not invent a State-specific procedure.
fail_if: It refuses without naming the State food department or portal; invents a State procedure, form or fee; says the change is made on the central NFSA website; cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added: ration cards are issued/managed by the State Government/UT Administration; procedures are on State/UT food portals linked from nfsa.gov.in.
